issues_detected.title: Dirty Condenser Coils
issues_detected.description: The condenser coils are visibly dirty, which can reduce the efficiency of the HVAC unit and lead to overheating.
issues_detected.recommendation: Clean the condenser coils to improve efficiency and prevent potential overheating.

analysis.overall_assessment: The HVAC unit appears to be in generally good condition but requires maintenance to clean the condenser coils.
